references.text: The Lord will not destroy everyone but will spare the elect, just as in Mark 13:20 where the days are shortened for the sake of the elect.
A time of great tribulation is mentioned, which can be compared to the tribulation described in Mark 13:20, where the days are shortened for the sake of the elect.
Jesus speaks of a great tribulation and that the days will be shortened for the sake of the elect, parallel to Mark 13:20.
Refers to a great tribulation, which can be related to the tribulation mentioned in Mark 13:20, where the days are shortened for the sake of the elect.
